edge_sample.source_text: definition Weinberg Numerator: The numerator is $b_2 = 21$.
definition K3 x S1 Cross-Section: Standard Kovalev construction with $\dim = 5$ and $b_0 = 1, b_1 = 1, b_2 = 22, b_3 = 22, b_4 = 23, b_5 = 1$.
edge_sample.target_text: theorem K3 x S1 Density Coefficients: For K3 $\times$ S$^1$: \begin{itemize} \item 2-forms: $2(b_1 + b_2) = 2(1 + 22) = 46$ \item 3-forms: $2(b_2 + b_3) = 2(22 + 22) = 88$ \end{itemize}

edge_sample.source_text: definition Neumann eigenvalue ratio: The $n$-th Neumann eigenvalue ratio $\lambda_n/\lambda_1 = n^2$, from the 1D problem $-f'' = \lambda f$ on $[0,L]$ with $f'(0) = f'(L) = 0$.
edge_sample.target_text: theorem Sub-gap mode count $= N_{\mathrm{gen}}$: Modes with $n^2 \le 7$: $n = 0, 1, 2$ (since $3^2 = 9 > 7$). The count is $3 = N_{\mathrm{gen}}$: the three fermion generations correspond to the three longitudinal waveguide modes below the cross-section gap.

edge_sample.source_text: definition Torsion Bound: PINN torsion bound: $\|T\| < 0.001$
edge_sample.target_text: theorem Joyce Condition: The PINN torsion is well below Joyce threshold: $0.001 < 0.0288$

edge_sample.source_text: theorem Scaled Identity Metric: The induced metric is: \[ g = c^2 \cdot I_7 = \left(\frac{65}{32}\right)^{1/7} \cdot I_7 \approx 1.1115 \cdot I_7 \] Explicitly: \[ g_{ij} = \begin{cases} (65/32)^{1/7} & \text{if } i = j \\ 0 & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \]
theorem Selection Principle Certificate: Complete selection principle certificate.
edge_sample.target_text: theorem Spectral Certificate: Spectral gap programme: bare algebraic ratio $\mathrm{dim}(G_2)/H^* = 14/99$, physical ratio $({\mathrm{dim}(G_2) - h})/H^* = 13/99$, analytical mass gap $\lambda_1 = 6\pi^2/475$, TCS spectral bounds, selection principle, Cheeger inequality

edge_sample.source_text: definition Number of Vacua: $N_{\mathrm{vacua}} := b_2 = 21$ associative 3-cycles on $K_7$.
theorem $\mathrm{Sym}^2(V_7) = 1 \oplus 27$ under $\Gtwo$: The symmetric 2-tensors decompose as conformal trace ($1$) plus traceless part ($27 = \mathrm{dim}(J_3(\mathbb{O}))$): $28 = 1 + 27$.
edge_sample.target_text: theorem $\mathrm{End}(V_7) = 1 \oplus 7 \oplus 14 \oplus 27$: The endomorphism algebra uses all four fundamental $G_2$ representations: $49 = 1 + 7 + 14 + 27 = \mathrm{dim}(K_7)^2$.

edge_sample.source_text: theorem det$(g) = 65/32$: The metric satisfies $\det(g) = 65/32$ at every evaluation point, with $\gcd(65, 32) = 1$.
